title: Stop before the wall
goal: Drive to the cheese and **stop on it**. It sits right in front of a wall, so do not bump!
`ir(0)` is the front sensor. It reads about `1 / distance`: the closer the wall, the bigger the number.
hints: Use a `while` loop: keep driving while `ir(0)` is small.
The cheese starts where `ir(0)` is about `1`. Stop when it goes over `1.5`.
When the loop ends the program ends, and the mouse stops.
name: Stop before the wall
